- **LeBron James** – 35,367 career points for the franchise (as of the end of the 2023‑24 NBA season).

- LeBron James remains the Lakers’ highest‑scoring player for the season, averaging the most points per game among the roster. (If you’re looking for the most recent per‑game average, it’s around 27–28 ppg.)
